note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/api/a2a.reason: The image fleet marker and the chat-resolvable record a dev-fleet image seeds at boot (engineering#666). MEASURED, NOT ARGUED, in one environment by scripts/route-graph.mjs with the companion extension fleet cloned PINNED, exactly as CI measures: the branch tree with both new edges REMOVED lands on 1888 for /chat — main's own committed ceiling, headroom 0 — so nothing of main's is folded into this raise, and the whole of the +3 is this branch's. ATTRIBUTED, one edge at a time on the same tree: +1 is src/lib/bundled-fleet.ts, the fail-soft reader of the marker the image build writes, which the static-bundle seeder must read to know whether it is booting a required-only image (today's seed set exactly) or a dev-fleet preview instance; measured at 1889 with that edge alone. +2 is the agent-record road the dev branch takes — @cinatra-ai/agents/seed-bundled-agent-template (the seeder of the agent_templates row the chat's run resolver reads) and @/lib/required-extension-materialize (the GUARDED resolver of the image's own OAS seed directory, whose boundary check is the reason it is reused instead of re-derived) — measured at 1891 with the whole change. The growth is ADDITIVE: no module leaves any route's reachable set. NARROWING IS UNAVAILABLE at this size: the seeder is reachable from all four routes by construction, scripts/route-graph.mjs counts a dynamic import() specifier as the same graph pressure as a static one so deferring the edges would not lower the count, and the only way to drop the third module would be to re-derive the seed directory without its user-store boundary guard, which is the guard that exists to stop a misconfigured deploy value from crossing it. /sign-in reaches none of it and keeps its committed ceiling and its own record untouched. The records main carries for these four routes are RETIRED BY THIS RAISE, the one lifecycle the gate allows for an annotation whose ceiling moves.
